objective:
Deploy one contract: WordsmithHook, a standalone Uniswap v4 hook with no token and no pool of its own, on Robinhood Chain. It must be usable by anyone initializing a new pool with it on the PoolManager passed as a constructor argument (Robinhood Chain PoolManager 0x8366a39CC670B4001A1121B8F6A443A643e40951).
The hook does exactly what the creator describes below, and nothing else.
In the creator’s own words: <description>A hook for a pool where the other currency is native ETH. Take a 0.5% fee on the ETH side of every buy and every sell, settled in ETH inside the swap that paid it; when the PoolManager cannot pay it directly, mint a claim that anyone may redeem to the recipient by calling claimFees(). The recipient is 0x5Bff2a2FEcD1d6152676813b21346238733bEAB1. For the first 30 minutes after the pool opens, no wallet may buy more than 0.5% of the pool's token supply in total; after that there is no limit; expose windowClosesAt() as a view. There are no owner functions: nothing can be paused, changed or upgraded after deployment. Do not use any other pool, token or outside service.</description>
No owner functions, no backend signer, no upgrade path.
Fees are always taken from the ETH (pair currency) side, never from the pool’s token; a fee the PoolManager cannot pay directly is minted as a claim the recipient can redeem.
Take the PoolManager as a constructor argument and enable only the callbacks the behavior above needs. The deployed address must carry the correct hook permission bits (mine a CREATE2 salt). Owner, if any, is $owner.
Keep the function names exactly as written so the storefront can show them. Composed with The Hooks Store.
blockedReason: node manifest: needs_input: WordsmithHook needs a mined CREATE2 salt so its address carries permission bits 0x20cc, but an evm_contracts launch deploys it at an unmined, launch-number-salted address, where its constructor reverts. The accepted source has no deployer contract, and this task may only edit launch.json and must use kind evm_contracts. — Should this launch become a univ4_hook manifest, whose deployer mines the hook salt, or should the source gain a deployer contract that CREATE2-deploys WordsmithHook with an off-chain-mined salt and then list that deployer in an evm_contracts launch.json?
